# monotaur_api_key (Resource)

Manages a Monotaur API key for a service account. API keys are write-once credentials: the key value is only returned by the API at creation time. Lost key values cannot be recovered — create a new key and delete the old one to rotate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "monotaur_service_account" "ci_bot" {
  name = "ci-bot"
}

resource "monotaur_api_key" "ci_bot_key" {
  name               = "ci-bot-key"
  environment        = "production"
  service_account_id = monotaur_service_account.ci_bot.id
}

# The key value is only available immediately after creation.
# Store it in a secret store rather than an output to avoid exposure.
output "ci_bot_key_prefix" {
  value       = monotaur_api_key.ci_bot_key.prefix
  description = "Non-sensitive prefix of the created API key (for identification)."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment` (String) The environment this API key is associated with.
- `name` (String) The name of the API key.
- `service_account_id` (String) The ID of the service account that owns this API key.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the API key expires (optional). Changing this value requires replacement.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the API key was created (assigned by the API).
- `created_by` (String) The identity that created this API key (assigned by the API).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the API key (assigned by the API).
- `key_value` (String, Sensitive) The API key value. Only available immediately after creation — not returned by the API on subsequent reads. Once lost, the key cannot be recovered; create a new key and delete this one to rotate. After import, this attribute will be empty — the key value is not recoverable.
- `last_used_at` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the API key was last used (assigned by the API, updated on use).
- `prefix` (String) A non-sensitive prefix of the API key value, useful for identification.
- `revoked_at` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the API key was revoked, if applicable (assigned by the API).
- `revoked_by` (String) The identity that revoked this API key, if applicable (assigned by the API).
